behaviour: A source_add op takes an id, an author name matching the author pattern and a block of source text of at most 1000 characters, and is refused for a missing or extra key, a malformed or over length author, or a blank, non text or over length source. Applying it appends the source to the ledger's sources list with a stamp and a record event naming the author and the source, unless that source is already present, in which case the ledger is left unchanged.
seam: scripts.swarm_ledger.ledger_sources.check and apply, registered as the source_add op in scripts.swarm_ledger.ledger_core.EXTENSION_OPS
